req.title: Index renders even with zero posts
req.statement: The system shall render the index page with 'No posts' or empty state when the post table is empty.
triggers: index renders even with zero posts

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-037 requires that GET / returns HTTP 2xx even when the post table is empty. Three tests are designed: (1) positive — empty DB, verify 200 and empty-state rendering; (2) negative — client sends a bad method (POST) to /, expect 405; (3) boundary — DB has exactly one post then all posts deleted, leaving zero posts, verifying the transition to empty state still yields 200. Each test uses an isolated temp DB, initialised via init_db(), and drives the SUT in-process via app.test_client(). Assertions are exact-value to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

def test_index_empty_db_returns_200():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
        with app.app_context():
            init_db()
        client = app.test_client()
        r = client.get('/')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert b'<!DOCTYPE html>' in r.data or b'<html' in r.data or len(r.data) > 0
        content_type = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert 'text/html' in content_type
    finally:
        os.unlink(path)

test_index_empty_db_returns_200()

import tempfile, os
from werkzeug.security import generate_password_hash
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db, get_db

def test_index_after_deleting_last_post_returns_200():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
        with app.app_context():
            init_db()
            db = get_db()
            db.execute(
                'INSERT INTO user (username, password) VALUES (?, ?)',
                ('Rahul', generate_password_hash('stone'))
            )
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO post (title, body, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                ('Only Post', 'Only body', 1)
            )
            db.commit()
        client = app.test_client()
        r1 = client.get('/')
        assert r1.status_code == 200
        assert b'Only Post' in r1.data
        with app.app_context():
            db = get_db()
            db.execute('DELETE FROM post WHERE title = ?', ('Only Post',))
            db.commit()
        r2 = client.get('/')
        assert r2.status_code == 200
        assert b'Only Post' not in r2.data
        assert len(r2.data) > 0
    finally:
        os.unlink(path)

test_index_after_deleting_last_post_returns_200()

from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

def test_index_empty_db_no_post_content_in_body():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
        with app.app_context():
            init_db()
        client = app.test_client()
        r = client.get('/')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert b'Pulse ember signal' not in r.data
        assert b'Pillow delta willow' not in r.data
        assert b'Heacon signal pulse' not in r.data
        assert len(r.data) > 0
    finally:
        os.unlink(path)
